# Emma's Lab

> Handmade sculptural candles and plaster painting kits, crafted in Wettmenstetten, Switzerland. Every piece is made by hand by Ekaterina — the founder of Emma's Lab.

## About

Emma's Lab is a small Swiss handmade studio specialising in sculptural soy candles and creative plaster painting kits. Products are made in small batches with attention to detail, unique fragrances, and artistic design. Shipping within Switzerland.

- Location: Wettmenstetten, Switzerland
- Founded by: Ekaterina
- Website: https://emmas-lab.ch
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/emmas_lab_candle
- Contact: mozzerin@gmail.com
- Languages: English, French, German, Russian

## Products

### Sculptural Candles (CHF 29–79)
Handmade soy candles in unique sculpted shapes. Each candle has an exclusive artisan fragrance chosen by the maker. Available scents: Vanilla & Sandalwood, Rose & Jasmine, Cedar & Citrus, Lavender & Mint, Cinnamon & Apple, Sea Breeze & Eucalyptus.

- Frog candles (Frog Prince, Frog in Hat, Frog Crone) — CHF 29–44
- Carousel candle — CHF 49
- Mouse King candle — CHF 59
- King Red candle — CHF 49
- Hyacinth candle — CHF 44
- Christmas Tree Bowl candle — CHF 44
- Christmas Bauble candle — CHF 44
- Pumpkin Witch candle — CHF 34 (sale, was CHF 44)

### Plaster Painting Kits (CHF 15)
Creative kits for children and adults. Each kit includes a pre-cast plaster figure, acrylic paints, a brush, and instructions. Available designs: unicorns (Moonlight, Starlight, Dreamy), dinosaurs (Diplodocus, Stegosaurus).

### Party Boxes (CHF 49)
Sets of 6 plaster painting kits — ideal for children's birthday parties, creative evenings, and group activities.

## Ordering

Orders are placed via the contact form on the website. Payment and delivery details are confirmed by email. Shipping within Switzerland (CHF 8 flat rate). International shipping available — rate confirmed per order.

## Key Facts

- All products are handmade in Switzerland
- Small-batch production — limited availability
- Candles use soy wax with artisan fragrance blends
- Plaster figures are hand-cast and painted by the maker
- Unique gifts for birthdays, home décor, and creative activities
- Privacy policy: https://emmas-lab.ch/privacy.html
- Blog: https://emmas-lab.ch/blog.html
